name: 04-mixed-full-and-partial-noise2
description: Simulated, 30 fps, 2 px landmark noise: full reps (80°, 75°, 85°, 70°) alternating with partial reps (115°, 120°, 112°, 118°). Every full rep counts; every partial rep gets exactly one "Go lower" (a partial event, live or at the top) and never counts. targetReps 30.
